title: Low degree junta node analysis work bound
statement: Let $n,k$ be nonnegative integers, let $P\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let the failure parameter lie in $(0,1/2]$. Write $r$ for the number of coordinates outside $P$, $\ell=k-\lfloor3k/4\rfloor$, $F$ for the prescribed low-degree Fourier family, $c$ for the coefficient-estimation sample count, and $D$ for the number of subsets of an $r$-element set of size at most $\ell$. The node-analysis work bound is $|F|c(\lfloor3k/4\rfloor+1)$ plus the low-degree junta polynomial work bound, plus $|F|+D$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite set of coordinates in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
